args.evidence: All35 car containers have one later object record and five node-tree roots. Node fields contain geometry record ID, flags, three floats at+8/+12/+16 and three zero floats at+20/+24/+28. FUN001208d0 copies those six fields into runtime nodes and recurses through children. GranTorino first rootID1 matches body geometryrecord1; descendants withID0 contain mount translations(+/-0.7485,0.3371,-1.3721) and(+/-0.7485,0.3231,1.5579), then descendant IDs7..14 whose bounds are small wheel-shaped local geometries. All35 trees have zero last-three float fields. Names include WHEEL_MOVING andWHEEL_STATIC; runtime state selection is not yet traced. Current GLBs preserve all geometries as independent records.
